name: blue-atmosphere
description: Réseau social géographique asynchrone — les messages voyagent vraiment.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.dev:https: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev:https"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run build -- --mode development
